import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import re

# Configuration
SEED = 42
RANDOM_STATE = 42
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load Data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv"))
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission_null.csv"))

print(f"Sample submission columns: {sample_submission.columns.tolist()}")


# Extract temporal features from Date column (from previous working solution)
def extract_hour(date_str):
    if pd.isna(date_str) or date_str == "":
        return -1
    try:
        if len(date_str) >= 13:
            hour = int(date_str[10:12])
            return hour
        else:
            return -1
    except:
        return -1


def is_evening_hour(date_str):
    hour = extract_hour(date_str)
    return 1 if hour is not None and hour >= 18 else 0


# Second person pronoun density feature
def second_person_density(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str) or pd.isna(text):
        return 0.0
    text = text.lower()
    # Second person words: you, your, yours, yourself, yourselves
    second_person_words = ["you", "your", "yours", "yourself", "yourselves"]
    total_words = sum(1 for word in text.split() if word)
    if total_words == 0:
        return 0.0
    count = sum(text.count(word) for word in second_person_words)
    return count / total_words


# Intensity features (capitalization and punctuation ratios)
def capitalize_ratio(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str) or pd.isna(text):
        return 0.0
    uppercase = sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper() and c.isalpha())
    total_letters = sum(1 for c in text if c.isalpha())
    return uppercase / total_letters if total_letters > 0 else 0.0


def exclamation_ratio(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str) or pd.isna(text):
        return 0.0
    exclamation_count = text.count("!")
    word_count = len(text.split())
    return exclamation_count / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0.0


def question_ratio(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str) or pd.isna(text):
        return 0.0
    question_count = text.count("?")
    word_count = len(text.split())
    return question_count / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0.0


# Apply features
train_df["hour"] = train_df["Date"].apply(extract_hour)
train_df["evening"] = train_df["Date"].apply(is_evening_hour)
train_df["second_person_density"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(second_person_density)
train_df["capitalize_ratio"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(capitalize_ratio)
train_df["exclamation_ratio"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(exclamation_ratio)
train_df["question_ratio"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(question_ratio)

test_df["hour"] = test_df["Date"].apply(extract_hour)
test_df["evening"] = test_df["Date"].apply(is_evening_hour)
test_df["second_person_density"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(second_person_density)
test_df["capitalize_ratio"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(capitalize_ratio)
test_df["exclamation_ratio"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(exclamation_ratio)
test_df["question_ratio"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(question_ratio)


# Stratified Split for Validation
val_ratio = 0.2
strat = train_df["Insult"].values
train_part, val_part = train_test_split(
    train_df, test_size=val_ratio, random_state=RANDOM_STATE, stratify=strat
)

# Feature Engineering
print("Vectorizing text...")

# Word-level TF-IDF
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=15000, ngram_range=(1, 2), stop_words="english", min_df=2
)

X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_part["Comment"].astype(str))
X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(val_part["Comment"].astype(str))
X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(test_df["Comment"].astype(str))

# Character-level TF-IDF
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(1, 5), max_features=12000, min_df=2
)

X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_part["Comment"].astype(str))
X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(val_part["Comment"].astype(str))
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df["Comment"].astype(str))

# Combine word and character features
from scipy.sparse import hstack

X_train_text = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char])
X_val_text = hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char])
X_test_text = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char])

# Add all features (temporal + new linguistic features)
train_features = np.column_stack(
    [
        train_part["hour"].values.astype(float),
        train_part["evening"].values.astype(float),
        train_part["second_person_density"].values,
        train_part["capitalize_ratio"].values,
        train_part["exclamation_ratio"].values,
        train_part["question_ratio"].values,
    ]
)

val_features = np.column_stack(
    [
        val_part["hour"].values.astype(float),
        val_part["evening"].values.astype(float),
        val_part["second_person_density"].values,
        val_part["capitalize_ratio"].values,
        val_part["exclamation_ratio"].values,
        val_part["question_ratio"].values,
    ]
)

test_features = np.column_stack(
    [
        test_df["hour"].values.astype(float),
        test_df["evening"].values.astype(float),
        test_df["second_person_density"].values,
        test_df["capitalize_ratio"].values,
        test_df["exclamation_ratio"].values,
        test_df["question_ratio"].values,
    ]
)

X_train_combined = hstack([X_train_text, train_features])
X_val_combined = hstack([X_val_text, val_features])
X_test_combined = hstack([X_test_text, test_features])

# Prepare LightGBM Data
lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_train_combined, label=train_part["Insult"].values)
lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(
    X_val_combined, label=val_part["Insult"].values, reference=lgb_train
)

# Define Hyperparameters
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.85,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": RANDOM_STATE,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
}

# Train Model
print("Training LightGBM model...")
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_set=lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=800,
    valid_sets=[lgb_val],
    valid_names=["val"],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

# Evaluate on Validation Set
print("Evaluating model on validation set...")
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val_combined)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(val_part["Insult"].values, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Predict on Test Set
print("Predicting on test set...")
test_preds = model.predict(X_test_combined)

# Prepare Submission
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Insult": test_preds,
        "Date": test_df["Date"],
        "Comment": test_df["Comment"].astype(str),
    }
)

# Save Submission
submission_path = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path}")
print("Script completed successfully.")
